notes: Batch 7 «رابط کاربری و ناوبری» (v1.11.66) — Groups 12+13 of the grouped audit. Group 12 (design system / themes): (1) D1 + S1: --warning-soft is now defined in both themes (dark rgba(224,168,63,.13), light rgba(146,64,14,.08) — the report's suggested values, equal to --warning-bg) instead of being referenced-but-undefined; an automatic undefined-token check (every var(--…) in styles.css must be a defined token) is now in the in-repo tests. (2) D2 + C4 + S6: the second, contradictory .crumb-sep definition (color: var(--border-strong), 1.62:1 light) is gone — one definition remains (color: var(--muted), 5.76:1 light); the split .book-chapter-card rule is merged into one; the same fold was applied to .pill-saved/.pill-backup, whose paddings were also overridden by a later density rule (the winning 6px 10px now lives in the base rules). The new lint checks for CONTRADICTORY duplicates (same selector + same property + different value, outside @media/@keyframes and :hover/:disabled/:focus states) rather than a strict one-definition count — a grouped rule plus an individual rule with disjoint properties (.gm-compare-wrap th, .sess-table th, th, select/textarea) is a legitimate pattern and stays. (3) M-UI3 VERIFIED-ALREADY-WORKING, no code change: the MutationObserver registered at load on ALL .modal-back elements already routes the shortcuts and bulk-delete modals through the shared focus path (modalOpened focuses the first focusable element, modalClosed restores focus with the deferred + fallback logic) — proven by a jsdom focus harness (open from a focused button, Esc, focus lands back on the opener) and pinned by a test. (4) M-UI5 + M1: the light chrome separation is fixed by darkening light --border-strong #c4ccd6 → #aab4c0 (1.85:1 vs the page, was 1.43:1) — NOT by darkening the sidebar: the contrast probe proved darkening the sidebar to #dde3e8 breaks the borderline muted pair (4.45:1, fails AA 4.5); all three borderline pairs stay intact (light muted on light sidebar 4.76, accent-text on light accent-soft 4.86, search placeholder on dark card 4.66). M1 (one primary per page): Settings bkNowBtn is a plain btn again; in Analytics analyzeBtn is primary only while the Gemini section is open (anPrintBtn is primary otherwise); in Calendar the primary swaps with the connection state — not connected → calConnectBtn is the primary, connected → calSyncBtn — and a disconnect now re-renders the panel so the swap follows immediately. (5) L-UI1 + خ-۵: one breadcrumb everywhere — the global bar hides on the Dashboard (single segment) and in the Testbook drill-down (the local bookCrumb already shows the path); opening the box editor appends the box title as the current segment. (6) Cleanup: L-UI7 — the static loading line is now in all 10 tabs' containers (program, assignments, testbook, remaining, exams, calendar, settings, analytics); L-UI10 — the reset card moved to the END of Settings and both destructive actions («بازنشانی داده‌ها» + «حذف اطلاعات B2») sit under one «منطقه خطر» heading; L-UI11 — the edit modal's date/start/end and total/completed/correct triples are in .form-row; L-UI12 — the 8/12/14/16px literals in padding declarations are tokens now (8→--s2, 12→--s3), pinned by a lint; C1/C2/C3/C6 dead code removed (--s7, --info-border, .field-error, the .stage-report-overlay print rule); S2 --s9: 48px added and used for main's bottom padding (6px/10px stay literal, documented); S3 the two opacity-based disabled rules (.pill-sync:disabled, .cal-add-btn:disabled) migrated to the U11 --disabled-text pattern; S4 the type scale completed (--fs-compact: 13px, --fs-display-lg/md/sm: 44/32/26px, --lh-relaxed: 1.8, --lh-loose: 1.9); S5 the seven single-use tokens are documented as deliberately separate (each equals another token in one theme only, so no value-identical merge exists). Group 13 (navigation & IA): sidebar groups are now «روزانه» (امروز، داشبورد، برنامه، عقب‌افتادگی‌ها) · «محتوا» (تکالیف، کتاب تست، آزمون‌ها) · «تحلیل و سیستم» (تحلیل، همگام‌سازی گوگل، تنظیمات) — tab order and G-prefix unchanged; a third badge on «تکالیف» shows the remaining-assignments count; theme/language removed from Settings (they stay in the topbar); the Gemini section in Analytics has a «مدیریت کلید» link to the key in Settings; the tab «برنامه ماهانه» is renamed «برنامه». خ-۴: every page has its one primary — Assignments gains «اولین تکلیف مانده» in its page-head (scrolls to + highlights the first undone assignment, خ-۲ pattern) and asgAddBtn is a plain btn. PR4 CLOSES, no code: exitSim() already confirms before exiting, so the backdrop click and the Esc path both confirm; the toast layer stays below the focus overlay by design (the sim shows no toasts while open). PR1 is NOT fixed here — the seq/ETag design is v1.11.67. i18n 1439/1439 (4 new keys: navGroupAnalysisSystem, asgFirstRemaining, gmKeyManage, setDangerTitle; 7 removed: navAnalysis, navGroupSystem, setTheme, setThemeDark, setThemeLight, setLang, setResetTitle — the last one lost its heading when the reset card moved into the danger zone).
